notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
- Fixed some Arabic and Japanese text not showing properly.
- Fixed an issue when the language is Arabic, and the player enters the Options menu, the Arabic button is not hovered.
- We applied a fix to an issue where, in Online Matches, some players get stuck in the Tips loading screen. We will continue monitoring this issue just in case.

[h3]ADDED FEATURES[/h3]
- "Blitzkrieg" the new gauge type! Now, players can choose to have gauges get filled via combat using the energy cannons, and not just pasively via time. This should make Specials be more, well, special. The old time-based gauge is still there, it is call "Fluid". We are still balancing out how much attacks should fill the gauges up. Basically, the equation for filling gauges is (Damage Infliction > Perfect Reflection > Reflection > Damage Incusion). For Perfectly Reflection, the faster the energy shot the less it fills the gauge and vice versa. We value your feed back! :D

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
- Human Rocket damage has been increased; 80 -> 180. They sting more now, so be careful :)

[h3]REWORKS[/h3]
- Vuux and Zil Zzal are debuffed with the mass of ships are greatly decreased whenever their specials are active. This should help counter play them with the Anti-Gravity Beam to repulse them away. Close combat specials such, namely Vuux and Zil Zzal's, have little counterplay options even for megamachines like Shim-Shim. To help with counterplay them a debuf has been added for both characters.
- Human rockets now interact with the Time Vortex as an enemy attack.
- To further smooth matches, we changed the Special so that they start out empty at the beginning of the match, to make them more precious.
- Rearranged the Server Lobby information to emphasis importance from top to bottom, (Mode, Rounds/Time/Stock, Gauge Type, Map).

notes.title: 4.1.2a Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Game optimized![/h2]
There was a particular bottleneck in the game logic, and a few graphical bottlenecks produced by the addition of the 3D stages.
The logic bottleneck was due to how the weapons effects were designed in a way that was CPU intense. We had plans of rewriting the main objects, such as the spaceships, to C++ to increase performance.
We were able to profile, and identify the exact problem, and we re-approached our original design to that particular area alone. And, LUCKILY! the game's performance greatly improved!!
Now better FPS!

As for the graphical bottlenecks, when we introduced the 3D stages, we were introduced to new issues we've never faced before lol
Mainly, the problem can be split into two major groups. The first group was the easier one, the level of detail of the objects on screen was two high. And, very forunately for us, Unreal Engine is built with a feature that enables the developer to modify the level of detail for objects on the fly, which remedied the performance immensly.
The second major issue was with the weapon effects. The look of the effects are highly different between when in 2D design to when in 3D design. Furthermore, we discovered that many of the effects spawns too many objects that eats at the GPU. So, we reworked the effects to spawn less while retaining the original visuals as much as possible. These two changes helped releive the GPU from a two major bottlenecks!

[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
- [i]Most bugs were produced basically by the reworks of the latest patch. So, we feel it's illogical to add them to this list.[/i]
-Text in the Arcade Entry Level 4 spills out of the screen.

[h3]ADDED FEATURES[/h3]
- [i]Notes.[/i]

[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
- [i]None[/i]

[h3]REWORKS[/h3]
- [i]As explained in the above parts here, the game has been reworked and optimized to reach better FPS.[/i]

notes.title: New 3D Stages
notes.content:
[h2]New 3D Stages![/h2]
Originally, the game had only one stage. And, that stage was a 2D one. From the start we wanted to create and add more stages to the game.
We tried to design more stages in keep the 2D setting. And, we have two designed for us to see how it would look. However, it didn't fit the style of the game in general. Furthermore, as a single person team, it was hard to find artists. So, we decided to go with free assets from the Unreal Marketplace to build 3D the new stages.
We will try to improve it further later, and smooth out any performance issues.
I hope you guys like it!

notes.title: Arcade Mode Added!
notes.content:
[h2]Arcade Mode Added![/h2]

Arcade mode was more complicated to develop than anticipated. It required several modules to be newly created for the purpose of delivering a real "Arcade" feel, such as a dialogue module, stage flow system. And also, we had to actually develop the stories of each character, and try hard to make them interesting and strike intrigue.

[h3]ADDED FEATURES[/h3]
[b]Arcade Mode[/b]
As we just mentioned above, arcade mode is now added! Yay! Yay! Yay!

[b]Mouse and Keyboard support added[/b]
This was a tricky one as well. We implemented the support for mouse and keyboard a way back, even before the release last year. However, there were issues with the mouse cursor not showing during certain situations, we gave up (too early maybe?). But, we like to be optimistic, and say it was for the best because there are essential modules related to the controls that we implemented later along the line that might have been more complicated to realize if  the mouse and keyboard support was there.

[h3]TWEAKS[/h3]
- Added Controls guide in the pause menu.
- We've listened to Mr. David Jaffe's opinion in his Stream, and now company logo is skippable.
- Due to a bug related to AI movement being effected by frame rate, we reduced the number of selectable frame rates, capped it at 90 frames per second.


[h3]BALANCE[/h3]
- To balance between the different shield strength of the spaceships, capturing a human recharges the shield with a fixed amount rather than fully restore and empower the shield.

[h3]REWORKS[/h3]
- [b]CPU's AI[/b]
The AI was developed in the latest phase upon release, since it was mostly for balancing the game to make it refined. However, honestly, we didn't take care of it enough to make the AI actually "intelligent".
Since, we during development of the Arcade mode, it was obvious that the AI was horrendous, and needs a rework.
- Renamed ZillZal's Special from [i]Sinew's of the Armada[/i] to [i]Sinew's of the Khurdan[/i], a result of the story crystallizing.
- P2~P4 can now control the pause menu.
- Changed the color of the Anti-Gravity nozzle and beam to be more distinguishable from the Gravity nozzle and beam.
- Reworked the main menu.
- Optimized the Shim Shim Fleet, to help with framerate when many of them appear.


[h3]BUG FIXES[/h3]
- Game Pause interrupts exeunts.
- The online rooms disallow joining when full.
- Framerate effecting AI's movement speed.

[h2]Online multiplayer feature has been added![/h2]

notes.title: Patch Update: 1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]REWORKS[/b]
[i]Shim-Shiiim[/i]
- Shim-Shim's Shim-Shiiim fleet now are vulnerable to all crowd control effects. Originally, Shim-Shim's fleet only were effected by force inducing fields, such as Qasim-Rad's Nebulas Arrow and Aqnor'Tul's Blackhole Onset. But, the task of taking down The Fleet when your ship doesn't have any CC can become rather daunting. So, in order to place Shim-Shim into level with all other pilots. Shim-Shim's fleet have been reworked to be also effected by all crowd control effects, such as Naaja's Writhing Sonance's disruption field, Ba Zaman's Time Vortex' movement modification, Sha'Llal's Soul Shard freezing effect - to not break Shim-Shim's fleet against Sha'Llal, the fleet are a little less effected by the Soul Shard than Shim-Shim's mega ship.

[i]Mothership Airspace[/i]
- The more mega ships'- Aqnor'Tul, Zil Zzal, Shim-Shim, sizes give them an unfair advantage against the less sizely ships when delivering humans to the mothership. The mega ships can sit in the far corners of the screen, and cannot be pushed out of the mothership airspace, while other ships can be easily wrestled out of it. To balance the playing field, the sizes and positions of the side motherships have been reworked.


[b]BALANCE[/b]
[i]Qasim'Rad[/i]
- Nebulas Arrow can be a bit oppressive at times, and can be very difficult to escape. So, the amount of oppressive power when hit by Nebulas Arrow was reduced.

[i]Shim-Shim[/i]
- Reflecting on the above rework, the time to live for the Shim-Shiiim fleet was increased slightly to help them remain in game even against crowd control.
- The cooldown of Shim-Shiiim was also increased slightly as well to smooth out the roughed edges of that [i]Special[/i].

[i]Zil Zzal[/i]
- The default weapon for Zil Zzal didn't reflect it's requirements to be a fearless space battle ship, especially since Zil Zzal has the slowest rate of fire and the slowest but the biggest projectile in the game. It's damage has been increased significantly.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]ADDED FEATURES[/b]
[i]Added command list![/i]
We've received several inquiries regarding a further detailed tutorial page or a command list to help with understanding the game. We've compiled several videos that explain the gameplay, rules, and character weaponry.
The command list can be accessed during the match by pressing start.
We'll continue to monitor feedback, and see how this change impact the players.

[b]REWORK[/b]
- Updated resized several game text contents.
